CalendarId.description: The ID of the calendar for this block of time.

DisplayText.description: The display text shown in the calendar for the time block.

Effort.description: The amount of effort required for this block of time.

End.description: The end time for the block.

IsActivity.description: Indicates whether the block of time refers to an activity.

SourceId.description: The ID of the record referred to in the time block.

SourceTypeCode.description: The type of entity referred to in the time block.

Start.description: The start time for the block.

SubCode.description: Information about the time block such as whether it is an appointment, break, or holiday.

TimeCode.description: Indicates whether the time block is available, busy, filtered or unavailable.
